Headline RACHA RECIENTE enters in two weighted lines; Spanish team names Union Saint-Gilloise and Hapoel Be'er Sheva sit as opposing type blocks. Three outcome words Victorias, Empates, Derrotas stamp in sequence, each with a lime underline and slate echo; no statistical axes, no sample claims and no invented match events. Temporal stages: headline lock, team blocks slide from opposite edges, outcome words hit on the spoken beat. Typography uses a condensed sports sans for headline and tabular numerals for later data. Camera slow push in with slight parallax; emphasis on the sharpest lime beat. Transition is a hard cut on the voice beat; exit collapses type into the lower quarter. Reserve the lower quarter for permanent yellow subtitles. Statistical variant: grouped horizontal count bars with shared zero baseline and common scale in partidos.
